title: 三方不一致且已经付款的发票
context: 采购＋财务联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 每采购单（本模拟正常一单一发票），实际接受数量按采购价计价，比较发票金额；找出金额差超过100分且已经付款的发票，并返回超付于合格收货金额的差值。
commonError: 已付款不代表货物、价格、发票均一致。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT po_id,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY po_id) SELECT b.supplier_invoice_id,b.po_id,b.billed_cents,b.paid_cents,a.received received_cents,b.billed_cents-a.received bill_difference_cents,b.paid_cents-a.received paid_difference_cents FROM v_invoice_balance b JOIN a ON a.po_id=b.po_id WHERE b.paid_cents>0 AND ABS(b.billed_cents-a.received)>100 ORDER BY ABS(b.billed_cents-a.received) DESC,b.supplier_invoice_id
